title: City Council District 2
statement: As we move forward with Phase II site remediation, I emphasize the importance of addressing economic momentum in Jack London, ensuring the success of Baylight District benefits the entire community. We've seen sustained growth and a boom in the area with 9/10 momentum, and I believe targeted support for local businesses and public safety is crucial to maintaining this trajectory.
